title: BD planning — industry and companion-software selection (20 Aug 2026)
content:
# 20 Aug 2026 | BD planning

**Attendees:** Apeiron — Powerhouse · Frank — Powerhouse Layer Zero · liberuum — Powerhouse · teep — Powerhouse · Wouter — Powerhouse

## Notes

### Recap

**Strategy**
- Finding short-term in consultancy projects
  - High-value
  - Not scalable in the long term
- Establishing PMF along the way, transitioning towards product revenue
  - Low-value
  - Scalable in the long term

**Requirements discovery**
- Industry that
  - is sufficiently decentralized, "network shaped"
  - has an established consultancy market with projects
    - that are high-value
    - can help us establish PMF
- Complementary software that
  - is sufficiently open-source
  - is deployed within the consultancy projects
  - offers us an ecosystem that we can tap into

### Industry / software ecosystems

**Construction industry**
- sufficiently decentralized with standardization
  - BIM / IFC as the primary symptoms
- can help establish PMF
- has the companion software
  - IFC ecosystem
  - Speckle
- well connected
- lacks established consultancy market

**Manufacturing industry**
- sufficiently decentralized with standardization
  - many factories are SMEs
  - standardised procurement and delivery: PPEP, …
- can help establish PMF
- has the companion software
  - UMH
  - Paperless
- Defense industry has a hard requirement to avoid dependencies on foreign commercial players
- well connected
- does have an established consultancy market
  - E.g. Industry Dynamics proposal to NIKO

**Healthcare industry**
- sufficiently decentralized: hospitals, https://www.buurtzorg.com/ , …
  - Operational decentralization
  - Medium budget decentralization e.g. in hospitals and industry organizations
- Standardization
  - FHIR, …
- ? can help establish PMF
- ? has the companion software candidates
  - openEHR
  - EHRCON26 — Amsterdam, 22–23 September
- not well connected atm
- has an established consultancy market
  - Better (ex-Marant)
  - https://www.agitavit.com/
  - …

**Insurance and banking industry**
- "Long tail of community banks and insurers"
- ? can help establish PMF
- ? has the companion software candidates
- potentially well connected
- has an established consultancy market…
  - but it may be dominated by the big players only
  - however software / app support is becoming increasingly a large part of the value proposition of banks/insurers

**Legal industry** — ?
**Finance and accounting** — ?
**Logistics and transportation** — ?
**Government & defense** — ?
**Energy and utilities** — ?

### Straight line to revenue generation

1. Identify the companion software
2. Build a demo with Powerhouse integration
3. Produce social media / marketing materials
   - Youtube recording of the demo
   - Blog post, linkedin post, tweet threads
   - Mini sites / landing pages for SEO/agent traffic
   - Conversion funnel to introduction calls
4. Actively target consultancy companies using the software
   - Categories
     - System integrators
     - ERP/… integrators
     - Management consultancy
     - AI change management
     - …
   - Conversion funnel to introduction calls
   - Our specific ask: "You already offer <software X> to your clients. Consider including Powerhouse to your offering as we integrate with <software X> for <missing functionality>."
     - Intelligent document processing (IDP)
     - Structured data and business intelligence
     - Document models
     - APIs
     - Workflow automation
     - App development platform
     - Customized Vetra with pre-integrated industry-specific and company-specific data sources and services

### Next steps
- Score and rank companion software candidates
- Create demo integrations / presentations

**What is Powerhouse?**
- See Powerhouse x NIKO
- See https://ph-enterprise.vercel.app/
- Wouter — Powerhouse to update the brief.

**What can I use it for?**
- Intelligent document processing (IDP)
- Structured data and business intelligence
- App development platform

**How can I get started?**
- Brush up the tutorials and installation manuals

**How can I access consultancy services?**

### Demo scenario / storyline — Paperless
- Get structured data from your documents
- Tag a document as an invoice
- But how much money was spent?
- Use the structured data
  - for analytics
  - for workflow automation

**Scenario**
- **Step 1: set up and configure paperless**
  - configure email integration (POP/IMAP)
  - configure OCR, LLM, …
  - define the document types, tags, storage locations
- **Step 2: set up Powerhouse instance**
  - a) install Switchboard + Connect + Postgres db
  - b) install powerhouse/invoice package with
    - drive app
    - document editors
    - analytics processor
  - c) install powerhouse/paperless with
    - paperless integration document
- **Step 3: enable paperless integration**
  - Set endpoint
  - Configure webhook
- **Step 3** — Expense invoicing
  - Select invoices/receipts and turn into invoice line items
- **Step 4** — Automated payments


## Addendum (recorded 20 Aug 2026, after the notes above)

- **Deadline for the demo scenario: 28 August 2026.**
- **Frank** — Step 1 (set up and configure Paperless) and Step 2 (set up the Powerhouse instance).
- **liberuum** — Step 2.b (install the `powerhouse/invoice` package: drive app, document editors, analytics processor).


## Revision (20 Aug 2026, 11:41–11:45 — Wouter)

**Timing**
- Demo building **and** marketing materials finished by **28 August**.
- **Outreach in the week of 31 August** — a separate, later phase.

**Step 2.b expanded — `powerhouse/invoice` package**
- drive app **with invoice list**
- invoice document editor
  - **issuer/payer in modal**
- analytics processor

**New phase — Outreach to potential consultancy partners**
- Select them for this specific use case
- Link to their work / writings / talk about paperless
- Identify best way of contacting + contact person
- Document the specific hook:
  - *"I read your blog article here… wonder if you would be interested in our integration (blog url). Happy to discuss it more."*, channel: **LinkedIn**
- …

**Assignment comments on the shared document:** @frank@powerhouse.inc against steps 1–2, @liberuum@powerhouse.inc
against 2.b, @apeiron@powerhouse.inc against the outreach block. Frank and liberuum are confirmed; the outreach
owner is inferred from comment position and is UNCONFIRMED.


## Revision 2 (20 Aug 2026 — owners confirmed)

**How can I access consultancy services?**
- Enterprise landing pages
  - for SEO/agent traffic
  - for sharing with consultancy targets
- Cfr. https://wz-it.com/en/expertises/paperless-ngx/

**Owners confirmed**
- **Teep** — enterprise landing pages.
- **Apeiron** — outreach to potential consultancy partners.
- Steps 3–5 (enable integration, expense invoicing, automated payments) — **Frank & liberuum jointly**.
